{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter out rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0
valid_data = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]

# Calculate the change in biomarker levels (endpoint - baseline)
valid_data['change'] = valid_data['biomarker_final'] - valid_data['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean change across all valid patients
mean_change = valid_data['change'].mean()
